steps.caption: JobCam
steps.narration: JobCam keeps every job-site photo and video in one feed. Here is how to find a shot.

steps.caption: Recent
steps.narration: Recent shows every job's shots, newest first.

steps.caption: Tag, eye, star
steps.narration: Each shot shows its tag. The eye means the client can see it. The star marks a favorite.

steps.caption: Search
steps.narration: Search by project, address, tag or person. We'll type Issue.

steps.caption: One result
steps.narration: Only the shot tagged Issue is left.

steps.caption: Tags
steps.narration: Tags lists every tag, with how many shots carry it.

steps.caption: Progress
steps.narration: Tick Progress, and the feed keeps the three progress shots.

steps.caption: Close the list
steps.narration: Close the list when you are done.

steps.caption: Starred
steps.narration: Starred keeps only the starred shots.

steps.caption: Starred off
steps.narration: Click it again to turn it off.

steps.caption: Photos, Videos
steps.narration: Photos and Videos show one kind at a time.

steps.caption: Dates
steps.narration: Dates adds a from and a to date, to narrow the feed to those days.

steps.caption: Storage
steps.narration: Storage shows how much space your shots use.

steps.caption: Menu: JobCam
steps.narration: You'll find JobCam in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to find job-site photos in the JobCam feed | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of the JobCam feed in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will search the feed, filter it by tag, keep only starred shots, and narrow it to a range of dates.
